subject: NatWest enlists Nvidia to help its AI spending tool understand regional accents
text:
Source: https://www.finextra.com/newsarticle/48586/natwest-enlists-nvidia-to-help-its-ai-spending-tool-understand-regional-accents (~07:01 WIB 15 Oct)
Why it fits: NatWest used Nvidia Nemotron in its spending-insights tool and says it had 20% fewer mishears across the accents tested. A follow-up to the 28 Sep NatWest voice brief, not a duplicate. Note: source.mjs reads this page only through Finextra's feed summary, which does not carry the 20% figure; find a readable source for the number (NatWest or Nvidia's own release) or brief without it. (Filed by Site Watch, relayed by Marc.)
